name: web-browser
description: Read public web pages in a headless browser: readable text or markdown, links, CSS-selector extraction and screenshots. Public hosts only, robots.txt respected, no clicking or typing.

nodes.title: Fetch web page
nodes.description: Open a public web page in a headless browser and return its title, meta description, readable main text (optionally markdown) and links. Read-only: no clicking, typing or logins.

url.description: Page to open: an http:// or https:// URL on a public host (loopback, private and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

main_content_only.description: Keep only the main content (article/main), without navigation, footers and sidebars

include_markdown.description: Also return the content as markdown (headings, lists, links, tables)

max_chars.description: Cut the text (and markdown) after this many characters

max_links.description: Links to return from the content (0 for none)

wait_until.description: When the page counts as loaded: `load` (default), `domcontentloaded` (faster), or `networkidle` (no requests for 500 ms; for pages that render with JavaScript)

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for after loading, e.g. "article h1" (for content rendered later by JavaScript)

timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed for loading and waiting, in seconds

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get page links
nodes.description: Open a public web page and list its unique http(s) links (url and text), optionally only the same host/domain or matching a wildcard pattern such as "*/blog/*".

url.description: Page to open: an http:// or https:// URL on a public host (loopback, private and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

pattern.description: Wildcard (*) matched against the full link URL, case-insensitive; without * it matches anywhere in the URL (max 300 chars)

wait_until.description: When the page counts as loaded: `load` (default), `domcontentloaded` (faster), or `networkidle` (no requests for 500 ms; for pages that render with JavaScript)

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for after loading, e.g. "article h1" (for content rendered later by JavaScript)

timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed for loading and waiting, in seconds

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Extract from page
nodes.description: Open a public web page and read values with CSS selectors: `fields` maps names to a selector string (text of the first match) or {selector, attribute?, all?}. CSS only; no scripts.

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for after loading, e.g. "article h1" (for content rendered later by JavaScript)

timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed for loading and waiting, in seconds

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Screenshot web page
nodes.description: Open a public web page and save a PNG screenshot (viewport, or full page up to max_height pixels) in WEB_BROWSER_SCREENSHOT_DIR; returns the file path.

url.description: Page to open: an http:// or https:// URL on a public host (loopback, private and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

full_page.description: Capture the whole page height (up to max_height) instead of the viewport

max_height.description: Full-page screenshots are cut at this height

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
